text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
A member of our family has been appointed 
to serve as the ambassador for Satono 
Resorts.

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I'm planning a 
presentation. I'd like both of you to 
attend on the day—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Please allow me to do my utmost 
for the clan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, until the presentation begins, 
the press will be free to explore the 
venue."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In that case... we'll need more chairs! 
They need to be able to rest their feet 
while seeing every corner.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems there are no more chairs 
in stock. The budget has already been 
finalized, too. ...There's nothing we can 
do at this point.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When checking the guest transportation 
plan, I spotted a lumber disposal site! 
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You're having the tech department 
use that wood to make chairs! I'll go give 
them a heads-up on the order!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's a lifesaver! And—you there, you 
used to be in the design department, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Staff B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yes! That's correct, but...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To determine the size of the chairs, we'll 
first need the revised layout blueprints.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Could you lend me your strength?

text_block_list.name: Satono Family Staff B
text_block_list.text:
...! Of course! It's for the Satono 
family—for Crown-san! I'll draw it at 
supersonic speed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! I'll handle negotiating for and 
procuring the wood from the scrap yard! 
—Now, let's get started!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, an impressive display of skill.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I shall accompany you. You will surely 
need a hand, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Just hauling the timber is this 
backbreaking. This is going to be quite a 
chore."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, are you alright? It's 
almost time for your self-training, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Anaerobic exercise from carrying lumber. 
Aerobic exercise from walking afterward.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This is a wonderful workout too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: !? That's true, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, there's no way I can't give 
it my all! Alright, one more big push!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today. Now, 
all that's left is to wait for the big 
day!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You were a huge help. Without your 
proactive execution on-site, it would have 
taken us a few more days.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If we're talking about that, the same 
goes for me. Your flexible thinking, your 
drive. Everything was remarkable."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: By the way—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...... And that is?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Ummm. This is some herbal tea to thank 
you for today!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
These tea leaves have fatigue-relieving 
properties. Even if it doesn't feel like 
labor to you, fatigue must be accumulating 
in your body.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see. Here's the protein I owe you 
in return.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right after working out, replenish your 
protein immediately. Before your muscle 
starts breaking down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Since we have the chance, shall we 
have a tea party?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Oh, it's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I don't taste the blandness of the 
protein at all. Perhaps the tea leaves 
soften it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ If it weren't for each other, we 
never would have discovered how delicious 
this is... right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I could put this idea to 
use somehow?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And so, what we ended up with is that 
protein tea! How is it?
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A product name...! Come to think of it, we 
haven't decided on one yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Let's brainstorm right away! Together, 
we'll definitely come up with a great 
name. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, I told you already! It's protein tea.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Prioritizing simplicity is the best♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A product name...! Come to think of it, we 
haven't decided on one yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like we have a meeting tonight.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Combo merchandise...! I see. Making a 
series out of it is an option too, then. 
Which means the next ingredient is..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"There are options besides protein, you 
know. Broccoli, boiled eggs, chicken 
tenderloin..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
High in protein and with nothing but light 
flavors! ...Not bad at all! My chef's 
blood is pumping!
